questions.question: A man of God from Judah spoke against King Jeroboam's altar in Bethel. What sign did he say the LORD would give?
When King Jeroboam stretched out his hand and ordered the man of God seized, what happened to his hand?

answers.text: It shook and would not stop

questions.question: An old prophet in Bethel told the man of God from Judah that an angel said to bring him home to eat. True or false: the old prophet was lying.
Why did an old prophet in Bethel ask to be buried beside the man of God from Judah?

answers.text: The man's message will surely come true
The man had asked to be buried with him
The king had commanded it for prophets
